RoadMap Python Telemetry Setup Guide

Running RoadMap in Unreal
-------------------------

The Unreal project uses this packaged executable:

frontend/Content/ThirdParty/python_pipeline/telemetry/run_pipeline.exe

Python and a virtual environment are not required for normal Unreal use. If the
telemetry panel reports that the executable is missing, rebuild it using the
development steps below and copy it to the frontend folder.


Python development setup
------------------------

Use these steps only when changing or testing the telemetry Python code.

1. Install a compatible Python version. The current packaged build uses Python
   3.14.

2. Open PowerShell in:

   roadmap/python_pipeline/telemetry

3. Create the virtual environment:

   python -m venv .venv

4. Install the dependencies:

   .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt

5. From the repository root, run the tests:

   & .\python_pipeline\telemetry\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest python_pipeline/telemetry/tests -q

6. Build the packaged telemetry executable:

   & .\scripts\build_all.ps1 -SkipSim -SkipSync

The build writes the development copy to:

python_pipeline/telemetry/dist/run_pipeline.exe


Expected Unreal workflow
------------------------

1. Select a map and run a simulation.
2. Stop the simulation so its telemetry is saved under outputs/runs/<map-id>/.
3. Open Telemetry and select one of the newest runs for that map.
4. Review the Overview tab.
5. Generate heatmaps as needed from the Heatmaps tab.
6. Use the FDOT tab only when that map has an FDOT mapping file.


Do not commit generated files
-----------------------------

- .venv/
- build/
- dist/
- outputs/
- __pycache__/
- telemetry_done.txt
